description: This file defines the ChartService class within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin, responsible for retrieving and processing employee distribution data by subunit and location. It interacts with the ChartDao data access object to fetch raw data and transforms it for use elsewhere in the application.

classes.name: ChartService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to fetch and process employee distribution data for dashboard charts in the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getChartDao
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns the ChartDao object used for data access.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Retrieves employee distribution by subunit, sorted and sliced according to the specified limit, including an 'other' category.

methods.name: getLocationUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of unassigned employees based on total active employees and employees assigned to locations.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Retrieves employee distribution by location, including an unassigned count, and processes data limited by the specified threshold.
